c2-chain.title: Four-Clause Fluency
c2-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + بس/و + نتيجة + و + تفصيل إضافي
c2-chain.explanation: This is the top of the course: sentences that pack four full clauses together the way a fluent speaker actually talks -- a statement, its reason, a contrast or addition, and one more detail, all in a single breath: لازم أروح البيت الحين لأن تعبان كثير، بس أبغى أشرب قهوة زين، وبعدين أشرب مويه (I have to go home now because I'm very tired, but I want to drink good coffee, and then I'll drink water). Nothing here is new grammar -- it's the same simple pieces from the whole course, just chained at native speed.
c2-chain.fact: Reaching this level means you can follow (and produce) Gulf Arabic the way it's actually spoken in a real conversation -- not textbook sentences, but the long, looping, reason-then-detail style that native speakers use without even thinking about it.

dialogue.native: لازم أروح البيت الحين لأن تعبان كثير، بس أبغى أشرب قهوة زين، وبعدين أشرب مويه
dialogue.en: I have to go home now because I'm very tired, but I want to drink good coffee, and then I'll drink water

dialogue.native: زين، وأنا لازم أروح بيت أهلي لأن ما شفتهم كثير، بس عندي شغل بعدين
dialogue.en: Okay, and I have to go to my family's house because I haven't seen them much, but I have work later
